articles.title: Connecticut's new lawsuit against Kalshi piles on to prediction market legal fight
articles.snippet: The courtroom combat across state and federal courts is so far producing roughly split outcomes, suggesting a big job may be coming for the Supreme Court.

articles.title: Mirae Asset eyes $109 billion crypto empire after acquiring Digital X
articles.snippet: Park Hyeon-joo, Mirae Asset Financial Group’s founder, outlined his ambitious stablecoin, RWAs, and STOs plan for Digital X, formerly known as Korbit, in an event for his employees.

articles.title: Bitcoin tests its largest supply wall at $80,000, near ETF holders’ average price
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is testing its largest supply cluster alongside the key 50-week moving average.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin trades near $80,000 as stocks close with gains
articles.snippet: U.S. spot bitcoin funds have taken in $2.8 billion since the run began, and ether ETFs are matching it day for day. Three sessions are left to make August their best month since October 2025.

articles.title: Mirae Asset lays out crypto, stablecoin, tokenization plans for Digital X
articles.snippet: The South Korean financial group plans to build a $109 billion digital asset business spanning crypto, stablecoins and tokenized assets, according to The Korea Times.
